annotation.title_clean: Exoneration Clauses in Robot Trading Agreements in the Indonesian Consumer Protection Legal System
annotation.title_en: Exoneration Clauses in Robot Trading Agreements in the Indonesian Consumer Protection Legal System
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Raihan, M H; Multazam, M T
annotation.summary_en: Normative legal preprint (undergraduate thesis) analysing exoneration clauses in software trading-robot agreements under Indonesian consumer protection law. It finds sectoral rules may allow such clauses if transparent, but clauses unilaterally shifting responsibility to consumers conflict with consumer law and can be void under lex superior derogat legi inferiori.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sectoral regulation may permit exemption clauses if they comply with transparency.
Clauses unilaterally shifting responsibility to consumers conflict with consumer protection principles.
Norm conflicts are resolved by hierarchy of laws (lex superior derogat legi inferiori).
Clauses conflicting with law can be declared null and void.
